name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based silver-gold development company advancing the Diablillos project, a fully permitted primary silver-gold deposit in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The company completed its Definitive Feasibility Study in June 2026 outlining a 9,000-tonne-per-day operation with a 25-year mine life and an after-tax NPV of C$4.2 billion, transitioning from explorer to developer with first production targeted for 2029. AbraSilver is backed by strategic shareholders including Kinross Gold and Eric Sprott and trades on the TSX under the symbol ABRA.
